note: Stream-json sessions of the pinned binary (the arguments of chat.rs::build_claude_args and --model claude-fable-5) against a stub /v1/messages. requests lists output_config.effort of each turn's model requests in order; responses are Claude Code's answers, and nothing else reached stdout before them. Top level: no --effort, a settings.json already in the config directory, apply_flag_settings between turns; requests[i] is the turn after applied[i], and claude_json_added holds the keys .claude.json gained between the first turn and the last, with their values. before_first_turn: apply_flag_settings sent before the first user message. effort_command_mid_tool_turn: launched with --effort high, /effort low written as an input at the first init of a turn whose first answer is a tool call, then one more turn; result_num_turns lists num_turns of every result line.
